subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw continue requiring an explicit `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The requested behavior changes fallback semantics for existing multi-account configurations, so a maintainer needs to accept the account-selection policy before the linked PR or a replacement can land.

options.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep Explicit Account Selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default account is disabled.

options.title: Require Channel-Owned Fallback
options.body: Ask for a channel-owned implementation if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the prior shared-resolver direction and has recent outbound/account-routing history near the policy decision.
